QuestInfo.name: Pipopa's Secret Assignment (2)
QuestInfo.0: #p9120014# wants you to disguise yourself and infiltrate the Yakuza as part of his plan to bring order back to Showa town. Talk to #p9120014# to learn more.
QuestInfo.1: #p9120014# told you to speak with #p9120015# in the middle of town for help getting into the Fire Raccoon Finance building.
QuestInfo.2: #p9120015# told you that a fake face scar isn't going to help you blend in with the Yakuza. It's hard to disagree with that, but without an alternate plan, you have no choice but to proceed.

0.0: The fake scar I gave you should help you blend in with the Yakuza. I should warn you, though, the last person I sent in got roughed up, even with the immaculate disguise I provided.
0.1: I'm sure you'll be fine though. Your looks could kill. Heheheh! Err... That was a joke.
0.2: Stop sitting around and go infiltrate the Fire Raccoon Finance building!

yes.0: All right, go see #p9120015# on the right side of town. He'll take you to the Fire Raccoon Finance building.

no.0: What are you so afraid of? Even if you get in a bind, someone with your skill will have no trouble getting out in one piece.

1.0: What can I do for you?

yes.0: You want to infiltrate the Fire Raccoon Finance building? Do you have any idea how dangerous that is? \r\n
yes.1: What's that crap you've got on your face? Did #p9120014# really think that would help you pass for Yakuza?
